categories.name: أَسْمَاءُ اللَّهِ الْمُتَعَلِّقَةُ بِالْقُدْرَةِ وَالْعِلْمِ
categories.nameEn: Names of Allah related to power and knowledge

items.verseEn: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

items.verse: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
items.verseEn: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

items.verse: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
items.verseEn: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,

items.verse: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍۢ قُوَّةًۭ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍۢ ضَعْفًۭا وَشَيْبَةًۭ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
items.verseEn: Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.

categories.name: أَفْعَالُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
categories.nameEn: Actions of the deniers in Surah Al-Mu'minun

items.verse: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
items.verseEn: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.
In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.

items.verse: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
items.verseEn: But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.

items.verse: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
items.verseEn: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

categories.name: أحوال الأبرار والأشقياء في سورة الأعلى
categories.nameEn: States of the Righteous and the Wretched in Surah Al-A'la

items.verseEn: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.
But the wretched one will avoid it

items.verse: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

items.verseEn: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
And never therefrom will they be absent.

harf.hint: The Arabic term for speech, often referring to the divine word
harf.arabicVerse: وَإِنْ أَحَدٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ٱسْتَجَارَكَ فَأَجِرْهُ حَتَّىٰ يَسْمَعَ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ أَبْلِغْهُ مَأْمَنَهُۥ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
harf.verse: 9:6 - And if any one of the polytheists seeks your protection, then grant him protection so that he may hear the words of Allāh [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Then deliver him to his place of safety. That is because they are a people who do not know.

deduction.title: The Prophet of the Carved Mountains
deduction.intro: In the harsh deserts of ancient Arabia, a figure emerged among people renowned for their extraordinary craftsmanship. Their homes rose from solid rock, yet their hearts were harder than the mountains they carved. A divine messenger arrived with a single, miraculous sign — but pride and defiance led to swift and terrifying consequences. Can you identify the noble servant whose people chose destruction over guidance?
clues: I was sent as a warner to my people, calling them to the worship of the One God.
My people lived among dramatic rock formations, carving magnificent dwellings into the mountainsides.
A miraculous she-camel emerged from solid rock at my prayer, a clear sign from the Almighty.
I told my people to share the water with this she-camel and not to harm it.
My people plotted against the she-camel and hamstrung her, sealing their own destruction.
A terrifying earthquake struck my people, and they were left fallen motionless in their dwellings.

trial.label: What was the defining trial?
options: The hamstringing of a miraculous she-camel
Building a great ark amid mockery
Being cast into a blazing fire
The breaking of the Sabbath covenant
trial.answer: The hamstringing of a miraculous she-camel

location.label: What was the central element?
options: A she-camel that emerged from rock
A staff that parted the sea
location.answer: A she-camel that emerged from rock

outcome.label: What was their ultimate fate?
options: A sudden earthquake from the heavens
Their cities overturned by divine command
outcome.answer: A sudden earthquake from the heavens

deduction.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
deduction.verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)

translations: And leave Me and the deniers
scramble.hint: A verse about the special night vigil prayer (Tahajjud) and the noble 'Maqam Mahmud' (praised station) promised by Allah.
scramble.arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
scramble.verseEn: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
